issues_detected.title: Water Damage on Cabinet Floor
issues_detected.description: The plywood base of the cabinet shows signs of water damage, including discoloration and potential mold growth. This suggests a previous or ongoing leak from the plumbing above.
issues_detected.recommendation: Inspect and repair any leaks in the plumbing. Replace the damaged plywood to prevent mold growth and structural issues.

issues_detected.title: Potential Mold Growth
issues_detected.description: Dark spots on the cabinet floor indicate possible mold growth due to moisture exposure.
issues_detected.recommendation: Conduct a mold assessment and remediation if necessary to ensure a safe environment.

analysis.overall_assessment: The under-sink cabinet shows signs of water damage and possible mold growth, indicating a plumbing issue that needs to be addressed.
